song.title: Canadian Crop Dusting
song.description: Try not to blush. A grocery-aisle comment thread becomes Canadian Crop Dusting: a cheeky dubstep remix from the From sample to song experiment.

lyrics.text:
[Intro]
Somebody ripped a big one
Same grocery aisle as me
Shifted—
and carried on...

[Part 3]
Thank you, yellow top.

[Verse 1]
Walkin’ through the grocery store
Minding my own
Then the atmosphere changed

[Part 5]
They just shifted something
They kept walking
No remorse
No discussion

[Part 6]
Somebody yelled—
“Don’t lie, just admit it was you.”

[Pre-Drop]
I don’t fart she said

[Drop]
GOOD OL’ CANADIAN CROP DUSTING
PFFFT—
Do you guys smell popcorn?

[Part 10]
CANADIAN CROP DUSTING
Aisle seven turned into a danger zone

[Part 11]
Yellow top
Don’t stop
Drop one
Then shop like the Isles alone

[Part 12]
GOOD OL’ CANADIAN—
CROP. DUSTING.

[Verse 2]
“Changed tops before the picture, eh?”
The investigation gets deeper
One guy says it smelled like
Bananas and latex through the freezer

[Part 15]
Meanwhile yellow top is gone
Three aisles over
Buying flour

[Build]
Who dealt it?
Who smelled it?
Who felt it, queen for a day type of power

[Part 17]
She says—

[Part 18]
I. DON’T. FART.

[Drop]
GOOD OL’ CANADIAN CROP DUSTING
Rip—shift—carry on

[Part 20]
CANADIAN CROP DUSTING
By the time you smell it
The suspect’s gone

[Part 21]
No confession
No discussion
Just plausible deniability
and gastrointestinal percussion like a Russian spy dropping bombs on enemy territory

[Part 23]
yellow top. You smelt it you dealt it. You said the rhyme you did the crime. You denied it you supplied it. You farted (you're retarded)
